profile.headline: Senior Firmware | Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: “Enthusiastic Firmware/Embedded Software Engineer with over 9 years of experience in designing and developing embedded systems. Object-oriented programmer with a strong proficiency in real-time operating systems (RTOS). Possess fundamental knowledge  in Embedded Linux and Systems on Module (SoM). Experienced in interfacing with various communication protocols and devices. Proficient in version control using Git and automated CI/CD pipelines, with a strong background in Agile development methodologies and practices. Adept at delivering high-quality, reliable software solutions and contributing to all phases of the development lifecycle: from concept -> to system architecture -> to prototype -> to bring up and testing -> all the way to manufacturing”

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
At TPS, I have played a pivotal role in enhancing and refining our codebase to develop reliable products. One of
my primary responsibilities has been to introduce new features and address existing bugs while minimizing
disruptions to the core firmware, all while adhering to best software development practices. Key
accomplishments include:
● Developed a Battery Abstraction Layer: Created a layer for our Battery Management System (BMS)
that separates battery-agnostic code from vendor-specific requirements. This new implementation
replaced an outdated system, enabling better scalability and support for various battery
manufacturers.
● Engineered a Data Logger System: Designed and implemented a data logger to capture diagnostic
data for system error detection and warranty purposes, significantly improving our ability to
troubleshoot and ensure product reliability.
● Resolved CAN Message Overflow Issue: Investigated and addressed a critical overflow problem in
our CAN message handling, which was causing system failures. My thorough analysis and
understanding of the controller's functionality led to a successful resolution.
● Enhanced Development Efficiency: Introduced new tools and integrated additional tests into our
development workflow, enabling developers to execute comprehensive test suites before submitting
pull requests, thus improving overall code quality and efficiency.
● Implemented a Unit Test Framework: Developed and integrated a unit test framework into our build
pipeline, promoting best software development practices and increasing test coverage for existing
code.
These initiatives have significantly contributed to our product's stability and quality, demonstrating my
commitment to continuous improvement and excellence in software development.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
At ADM, my role encompasses developing embedded medical devices, leading a team of engineers, defining
project specifications and system architecture, and providing client support. From a low-level state machine
programmed in C to a Real-Time Operating System, my key responsibilities and achievements include:
● Firmware Development: Designed and implemented firmware for a pulsed electromagnetic device
aimed at reducing pain and inflammation. This project utilized an MSP430 processor from Texas
Instruments and involved developing a low-level state machine to control device functionality.
● Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) Design: Created a real-time operating system (TI-RTOS) to
manage medical device usage, facilitating a pay-per-use model. This involved integrating with an AWS
backend via HTTP commands and generating secured, encrypted data packets to accurately track
treatment counts.
● Graphical User Interface (GUI) Development: Developed user-friendly graphical interfaces and kiosk
designs using the Material-UI framework, React, and Flask, enhancing the user experience for medical
device operators.
● Automated CI/CD Pipelines: Implemented automated pipelines for continuous integration and
continuous deployment (CI/CD), utilizing Docker containers to build projects and perform integration
tests, thus streamlining the development process.
● Comprehensive Development Work: Engaged in all phases of development, including firmware
creation, board bring-up, and real-time debugging, ensuring robust and reliable medical device
performance.
My contributions at ADM demonstrate my expertise in embedded systems, leadership in engineering, and
commitment to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions in the medical device industry.

positions.title: Electronics Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
In my role, I was responsible for optimizing, automating, and documenting all facets of manufacturing
processes for electronic interconnection solutions across various industries, including aviation,
defense and space, energy, and transportation. My efforts focused on enhancing operational
efficiency, implementing automation strategies, and ensuring comprehensive documentation to
support quality and consistency in manufacturing.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer
positions.description:
Gained experience designing, integrating, and manufacturing electronic devices, including developing
hardware block diagrams, schematics, and wiring diagrams. My role also involved thorough
documentation of system designs and manufacturing processes to ensure clarity and consistency
throughout the project lifecycle.
